description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is hiring a Software Engineer to build and maintain its AI security product across the full technology stack. The role owns features from database design through interface development, testing, and deployment, while contributing to product decisions and engineering practices.
Full-stack TypeScript engineer building React interfaces, Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL data layers, and cloud deployments

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship full-stack features using TypeScript across the API, database, and web application
• Design, develop, and maintain PostgreSQL schemas and the data layer supporting the product
• Create clean, responsive, and usable interfaces with React
• Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js and REST APIs
• Deploy applications to a modern cloud environment and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines
• Write automated tests to maintain software quality and reduce the risk of regressions
• Consider potential security issues during development and test for vulnerabilities
• Take ownership of features from initial implementation through production deployment
• Contribute to product decisions and help establish engineering practices as the company grows

Requirements:
• Demonstrable evidence of software development ability through a portfolio, GitHub projects, shipped side projects, open-source contributions, Capture the Flag (CTF) achievements, or software used by real users
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and Node.js, with a solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals
• Working knowledge of REST APIs, relational databases, PostgreSQL, SQL, and data modeling
• Frontend development skills with React
• A security-conscious approach to software development, including the ability to anticipate potential problems and test for them
• Ability to work independently, make technical decisions, and take ownership of features without relying on a predefined backlog
• No specific degree or minimum number of years of professional experience is required. Candidates are evaluated on their demonstrated skills and the software they have built

Preferred:
• familiarity with Next.js
• Interest in or experience with artificial intelligence and large language model (LLM) applications
• Background in cybersecurity or application security
• Experience with cloud platforms, serverless technologies, or CI/CD pipelines
• A track record of delivering software projects end to end, supported by demonstrable work
